name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace. There is no JavaScript in this repo; these scripts are named entry points for the stdlib-only Python/shell self-checks, so agents, contributors and CI all invoke the same commands -- .github/workflows/ci.yml's PR-blocking job runs each of lint/test/test:layout/check:spec/check:regmap/check:fixtures/check:layout/check:floorplan/selftest.sh as its own step by calling `npm run <script>` (issue #97: the workflow is a runner over this file, not a second inventory that can drift out of sync with it). lint covers the Python/shell syntax check and the schematic text-block brace guard (design/netlist.py --lint, issue #61); test:layout runs layout/tests/ (unittest, stdlib-only, no klt/PDK needed) -- currently layout/tests/test_verify.py, which holds layout/verify.py's freshness-gate comparison (_stable()/compare_reports(), issue #148) to both halves of its own contract: a machine-local field (the PDK install path) must not trip it, and a real content change (a verdict, a rule/error count, a content hash) must; check:spec holds eleven spec-arithmetic derivations -- the two jitter-energy derivations (plain cell and shipped starved cell), the array sizing, the entropy-binding-corner claim (issue #13: the minimum-Q corner over the full covered 27-point PVT grid), the four ring-coupling variant guards (issues #51/#75), the two liveness-tap phase-cost guards (issues #76/#87), the sampled-bit-bias guard (issue #86), the time-to-first-valid floor, and the #14 power rollups -- to the committed evidence records; check:regmap holds the interface block's generated Verilog header and pinout document to the one normative register-map table. check:all adds the PDK-dependent checks (the sim stages, the schematic-vs-netlist staleness guard, the digital synthesis staleness guard, the post-route SDF staleness guard, and the layout DRC/LVS flow under --require-tools), which need ngspice >= 46, xschem, klayout-tools, yosys, openroad (or docker, for layout/openroad_docker.sh) and the gf180mcu PDK installed locally. check:digital-sdf regenerates layout/digital/trng_top.sdf to scratch and diffs it against what is committed (issue #147) -- unlike place-and-route itself, that artefact IS byte-reproducible for the same netlist and liberty, modulo write_sdf's own wall-clock timestamp. check:fixtures holds the committed layout test-cell GDS streams to their generator, check:layout runs the DRC/LVS flow, and check:floorplan rebuilds the entropy-source floorplan abstract, DRCs it and holds its area rollup to the committed artefacts -- the last two skip with exit 0 when klt or the PDK is absent, which is why check:all re-runs both in their demanding form.

scripts.lint: python3 -m compileall -q sim design layout && bash -n sim/selftest.sh && python3 design/netlist.py --lint
scripts.check:spec: python3 sim/tools/jitter_energy_law.py --check && python3 sim/tools/starved_cell_jitter_energy.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_sizing.py --check && python3 sim/tools/worst_corner_entropy.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_coupling_variants.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_coupling_buffer_variant.py --check && python3 sim/tools/liveness_tap_phase_variants.py --check && python3 sim/tools/array_liveness_tap_phase_variants.py --check && python3 sim/tools/sampler_bit_bias_variants.py --check && python3 sim/tools/time_to_first_valid.py --check && python3 sim/tools/power_rollup.py --check
scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:layout && npm run check:spec && npm run check:regmap && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:layout && npm run check:floorplan && sim/selftest.sh
scripts.check:all: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:layout && npm run check:spec && npm run check:regmap && npm run check:fixtures && npm run check:netlist && npm run check:digital-netlist && npm run check:digital-sdf && python3 layout/verify.py --require-tools && python3 layout/floorplan/floorplan.py --require-tools && sim/selftest.sh --require-pdk
